task.instruction: Find a recipe for a vegetarian lasagna under 600 calories per serving that has a prep time of less than 1 hour.

final_answer:
I found a match: Easy Vegetarian Spinach Lasagna (https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/229764/easy-vegetarian-spinach-lasagna/) on Allrecipes. It is rated 4.6 from 117 ratings.

- Calories: 305 per serving, well under 600. The recipe makes 6 servings.
- Prep time: 20 minutes, under 1 hour.
- Other times: It also needs 1 hour of cook time and 5 minutes of standing time, so the total is 1 hr 25 mins. If you meant total time under 1 hour, this one doesn't qualify.
- Ingredients: Spinach, ricotta, mozzarella, Parmesan, egg, pasta sauce and lasagna noodles. It has no meat.

I only checked this one recipe's page, not the other search results.

judge.rationale: The Allrecipes page shows Easy Vegetarian Spinach Lasagna with vegetarian ingredients, prep time 20 mins, and 305 calories per serving, satisfying all criteria.
